Ecuadorian Bread Pudding

1 1/2 cups milk

1/4 teaspoon salt

1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon

4 large eggs

1 cup sugar

2 cups bread, cubed

1/4 cup chopped walnuts

Israeli Cheese Bourekas

Ingredients

1 package (12 oz) sliced Italian bread

2 cups shredded cheddar cheese

1 tablespoon olive oil

2 garlic cloves, sliced

1 onion, diced

2 pounds ground beef (or turkey, if you prefer)

2 teaspoons dried parsley

2 teaspoons dried oregano

1 teaspoon salt

1/4 cup olive oil

1 cup bread crumbs

1/2 teaspoon salt

Preparation

Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Remove the skin from the onion and dice.  Mince the garlic.  Heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat.
